desc:
⚽ Welcome to Build a Blue Lock Character! ⚡

⚔️ Face off against other players in 1v1 draft battles!
🎲 Roll Blue Lock characters and put each one in a stat slot!
💪 Combine the best stats from different players to build the strongest striker!
🔗 Pair up rivals, duos and teammates for CHEMISTRY bonuses!
🏆 Win matches, earn Yen, build win streaks and climb the leaderboards!

📋 FEATURES 🔥
- 3 game modes: Default, Reverse and Blind!
- Open Flow Crates to unlock Flow auras!
- Collect chairs with their own VFX!
- Spin the Prize Wheel for a chance at Maestro's Throne! 👑
- Log in 7 days in a row to get the Destroyer Throne!
- Free gifts just for playing!

👥 Join the group for +10% Yen and a free gift!
💬 Found a bug or have a suggestion? Send feedback in-game!
⭐ Don't forget to like & favorite the game!
